item.title: FILM ROOM PODCAST: Eva Kaszuba joins Season 2 Episode 27
item.description: Welcome to Season 2 Episode 27 of the Film Room Podcast! Scranton Prep basketball player and swimmer Eva Kaszuba joins hosts Joe Baress and Joby Fawcett to discuss capturing District 2 gold in both sports, what it’s like balancing basketball and swimming, the importance of her family in her athletic journey, what it took for the basketball team to win a district title with five new starters, being a part of the Scranton Prep swimming community and more. item.title: MotorWorld Toyota fuels Team Allied
item.description: MotorWorld Toyota in Wilkes-Barre presented a $15,000 donation to support pediatric rehabilitation programs at Allied Services. The company, which has contributed more than $100,000 to the annual campaign over the past seven years, was a major sponsor of Team Allied Services, the charity team that runs the TCS New York City Marathon in support of pediatric rehabilitation. item.title: Froggy 101 spreads warmth through coat drive
item.description: United Neighborhood Centers of Northeastern Pennsylvania received a donation of more than 100 brand-new winter coats, along with hats and scarves, from Froggy 101 to support the Angel’s Attic Food & Clothing Pantry, located at 410 Olive St. in Scranton. These winter essentials were collected through Froggy 101’s annual coat drive and were distributed to families in need who visit the pantry. item.title: WMCHC partners with Reach Out and Read program
item.description: Wayne Memorial Community Health Centers has been approved as a partner with the Reach Out and Read program. Families coming into any of WMCHC’s four pediatric offices for well-child visits, ranging from infancy through age 5, will receive a new, age-appropriate book to take home. WMCHC was able to launch the program through $15,000 in grant funding from AllOne Foundation & Charities. item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Eva Kaszuba, Scranton Prep basketball and swimming
item.description: Scranton Prep’s junior’s two-sport standout was into heavy medal this weekend. First, Kaszuba totaled nine points, six rebounds, three assists and two steals to help the basketball team beat Valley View, 52-47, in the District 2 Class 4A final at Mohegan Arena — the Classics’ fourth straight title and eighth in nine years.
